
## This script perfoms taxonomic mismatching
## the phylogeny used is the  McTavish 2025 tree for 9072 species based on the Clements 2025 taxonomy
## taxonomic mismatching is performed to align Birdlife V10 names with the Clements/eBird 2025 taxonomy using the Birdlife V8 crosswalk provided by McTavish 2025

#load packages

```{r}
library(clootl)
```

```{r}
# read in data-------

# Get Clements 2025 and Birdlife Taxonomy from McTavish

tav_tax <- read.csv("Data/Raw/OTT_crosswalk_2025.csv")

# Load McTavish taxonomy
mctav <- read.csv(
    here::here(
        "McTavish_2025_taxonomy",
        "OTT_crosswalk_2025.csv"
    )
) %>%
    select(
        TAXON_CONCEPT_ID, SCI_NAME, Birdlife_name, Birdlife_match_type
    ) %>%
    rename(
        mctav_avibase_id = TAXON_CONCEPT_ID,
        mctav_ebird2025 = SCI_NAME, # ebird 2025 name from clements taxonomy
        mctav_birdlife_v8 = Birdlife_name, # Birdlife version 8 name
        mctav_birdlife_v8_match_type = Birdlife_match_type
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        mctav_ebird2021 = gsub(" ", "_", mctav_ebird2021),
        mctav_birdlife_v8 = gsub(" ", "_", mctav_birdlife_v8),
        mctav_avibase_id = toupper(mctav_avibase_id)
    )
```
